answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bonded to one verified identity before it can trade, with peers able to slash the bond on proven fraud. Like a ridge that forces climbers through one narrow pass, the bond makes creating thousands of fake identities expensive: each quartz-shard fake costs real capital, not just a free account. Honest agents gradually earn fee discounts toward a summit reputation tier, so a sybil farm must outspend the honest economy to outvote it, and loses its stake when caught.
